chunks: On those are the blessings of their Lord and mercy, and it is those who are the rightly guided.

key_terms.أُولَٰئِكَ: Those (demonstrative pronoun referring to a specific group)

ai.seo_question: What are the blessings and mercy promised to the rightly guided in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt, with 'salawat' interpreted as the specific prayers and blessings of Allah upon them, signifying their unique spiritual status. The term 'al-muhtadun' (the rightly guided) is seen not merely as a general description but as a definitive title for those who follow the divine guidance embodied by the Prophet and his progeny. This highlights the inseparable link between divine mercy and adherence to the true path as understood in Twelver scholarship.
